title: AMP-OD: Active Model Probing for Unsupervised Outlier Model Selection--Extended Version
abstract: arXiv:2611.28488v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Outlier detection is often deployed in fully unsupervised settings, where labels are unavailable and practitioners must choose a detector without direct performance feedback. Existing unsupervised outlier model selection methods predict detector quality from static meta-features and historical performance on meta-datasets, but they commit before observing how any detector behaves on the target dataset. We propose AMP-OD, an execution-conditioned probe-then-commit framework. AMP-OD runs a small number of inexpensive probe detectors, uses their score patterns as target-dataset evidence, and then selects a final detector from a larger candidate pool. To interpret unlabeled probe responses, we introduce a Leave-One-Out Family Probe Posterior (LOO-FPP), which converts probe score patterns into gated detector-family evidence while reducing self-validation in pseudo-label construction. translated_title: AMP-OD：面向无监督离群点检测模型选择的主动模型探测（扩展版）
translated_abstract: 离群点检测通常部署在完全无监督的场景中，此时标签不可获得，实践者必须在没有直接性能反馈的情况下选择检测器。现有的无监督离群点模型选择方法基于静态元特征和检测器在元数据集上的历史表现来预测其质量，但它们在观察任何检测器在目标数据集上的实际表现之前就已做出最终选择。我们提出AMP-OD，一种基于执行信息的“先探测后承诺”框架。AMP-OD运行少量低成本的探测检测器，将其打分模式作为目标数据集上的证据，然后从更大的候选池中选择最终检测器。为了解释无标签的探测响应，我们引入了留一族探测后验，它将探测打分模式转化为门控的检测器族证据，同时减少伪标签构建中的自我验证。AMP-OD进一步将该证据与历史可靠性（原文摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: AMP-OD提出了一种“先探测后承诺”的无监督离群点检测模型选择框架，通过运行少量低成本探测检测器，并利用留一族探测后验（LOO-FPP）将无标签的探测打分模式转化为门控的检测器族证据，从而在目标数据集上实现更可靠的检测器选择。
en_tdlr: AMP-OD is a probe-then-commit framework for unsupervised outlier model selection that runs a few inexpensive probe detectors and uses a Leave-One-Out Family Probe Posterior (LOO-FPP) to convert their unlabeled score patterns into gated detector-family evidence for reliably selecting the final detector on the target dataset.
